title: EcoRI and sticky ends
back: Palindrome GAATTC; cut between G and A on both strands → AATT overhangs. Cut vector and insert with the same enzyme; ligase seals.

title: Naming EcoRI
back: First restriction endonuclease studied: Hind II (1963).

title: Gel electrophoresis
back: Agarose from sea weed; ethidium bromide + UV shows orange bands; bands cut out and eluted.

title: pBR322
back: ori, rop, ampᴿ (PstI, PvuI) and tetᴿ (BamHI, SalI). Insertion at BamHI inactivates tetracycline resistance.

title: Cloning vector features
back: Our School Club is Small. Ori controls copy number; single cloning sites avoid cutting the vector into pieces.

title: Selecting recombinants
back: Insertional inactivation: foreign DNA in a gene destroys its function. Blue–white needs only one plate.

title: Making cells competent
back: Other routes: micro-injection (animal nucleus), gene gun with gold or tungsten (plants), disarmed pathogens.

title: PCR cycle
back: Denature → anneal primers → extend with Taq polymerase (Thermus aquaticus). About a billion-fold amplification.

title: PCR amplification
back: Perfect doubling each cycle; 30 cycles of one copy gives about 10⁹.

title: rDNA technology
back: Chilled ethanol precipitates DNA. Continuous culture keeps cells in log phase for more product.

title: Stirred-tank bioreactor
back: 100–1000 L; agitator, oxygen delivery (sparger), foam, temperature and pH control, sampling ports.

title: Downstream processing
back: Drugs also need clinical trials before marketing.
